01  Who We Are

A Personal-Touch Maintenance Partner for Your Property

Brodax JRM Mechanical Engineering Services was established in September 2025 with one goal: to be a maintenance partner facility managers and property owners can genuinely rely on. We combine structural, mechanical and electrical trades under one roof so you deal with a single accountable team instead of chasing multiple contractors.

From roof deck waterproofing and structural repairs to generator PMS and heavy equipment servicing, our crews are hands-on, punctual, and trained to leave every site cleaner than they found it.

Our Mission

To provide reliable, prompt, and professional facility maintenance services with a personal touch — ensuring total peace of mind for every customer.

Our Vision

To keep every client property running at its absolute best.

02  What We Do

Two Trades. One Reliable Crew.

Whether it's a leaking roof deck or a fleet forklift that won't start, we scope the job properly, quote it fairly, and get it done.

Structural Works

Repair and reinforcement of walls, gates, framing and structural fittings — built to hold up under everyday use.

Waterproofing

Roof deck and podium waterproofing that stops leaks at the source — proven on large-scale commercial roofs.

Painting

Interior and exterior painting for buildings and residences, finished clean with minimal disruption to occupants.

Aircon Installation & PMS

Split-type and central aircon installation, repair, and scheduled preventive maintenance for consistent cooling.

Generator Repair & PMS

Semi-annual preventive maintenance scheduling and repair for standby generator sets — currently servicing 9 units.

Building Repair & Maintenance

General upkeep and reactive repairs so small issues never turn into costly, disruptive ones.

Hydraulics System Repair

Diagnosis and repair of hydraulic systems for industrial and commercial equipment, restoring full working pressure.

Forklift Servicing

Routine servicing and repair to keep warehouse and yard forklifts safe, reliable, and downtime-free.

Pallet Truck Repair

Manual and electric pallet truck repair — keeping material handling moving on your warehouse floor.

Light Vehicle Service

Mechanical repair and maintenance for company light vehicles, keeping your fleet road-ready.

Vehicle Engine Overhauling

Full engine teardown, rebuild, and overhaul work carried out by an experienced mechanical crew.

Heavy Equipment

Repair and maintenance support for cranes and heavy site equipment, on-site or in our workshop.

03  How We Work

From First Call to Finished Job

A straightforward process built for facility managers and purchasing teams who need clarity, not surprises.

STEP 01

Inspect & Assess

We visit the site, assess the scope of work and document existing conditions before quoting anything.

STEP 02

Quote & Agree

A clear, itemized quotation is issued with materials, timeline and cost — no hidden charges.

STEP 03

Execute the Work

Our crew carries out the job on schedule, with safety gear and site protocols followed throughout.

STEP 04

PMS & Follow-Up

For equipment and generators, we set a preventive maintenance schedule so problems get caught early.

05  Meet the Founder

THE MAN BEHINDTHE SERVICE

Brodax JRM Mechanical Engineering Services is led by Renildo D. Jumawan, a seasoned facilities and maintenance professional with decades of hands-on experience in electrical work, building operations, and facilities management.

From hands-on electrical maintenance and preventive maintenance to supervising building operations and international facilities teams, his career has been built around one standard: identify the problem, fix it properly, and keep the property running as it should.

His career began on the technical side of facilities maintenance and grew into supervisory and management roles across residential properties, commercial buildings, manufacturing facilities, and international operations.

As a Building Electrician with IDAMA Facility Management, he handled electrical maintenance, repairs, preventive maintenance, wiring installations, electrical fixtures, testing and troubleshooting, conduit work, and the supervision and training of other workers.

He later took on broader facilities-management responsibilities, including work with the United Nations Mission in Africa, where he helped manage building services, maintenance operations, contractors, housekeeping teams, staff accommodations, and day-to-day facility support.

Today, through Brodax JRM Mechanical Engineering Services, Renildo brings that combination of hands-on technical skill and facilities-management experience directly to every project.
